## 0a9e3d364bb3

**Reproduced teaching defect; no source change applied.** The five-pair lesson window contains texture-specific shortcut killers only once, so rotating that sole witness into the query can leave the corresponding rival consistent with all four demonstrations. A source-bound census over 20 lessons per band materialized 60 lessons / 300 pairs and checked 300 rotations. It found 135 ambiguous rotations, 180 rotation-hook warnings, 0 materialization errors, 0 scoring errors, and 300 unique inputs. The audited generator SHA is `72b830df552a46ad27de60da75e75d7fd90cc1a95ddeb4afba4471ac0aac11d8`; declared rule hash `debd91c13f07`.

The retained exact counterexample is easy-band lesson/index 0, seed `2678160609`, requested start 0. Pair 1—the only `marker_not_in_key` texture—is held out, leaving demonstration indices `[0,2,3,4]`. The declared rival `marker_must_be_key` fits every demonstration but leaves query markers unchanged, while the official quadrant-key rule recolors them according to the body bounding box.

The query was materialized by the production sampler, passes direct `self_check` with no errors, and belongs to the documented domain. `checks/audit/0a9e3d364bb3/counterexample.json` contains the exact source-bound record and supported Racket output; the full census is `checks/audit/0a9e3d364bb3/lesson-census.json`.

**Scope.** This is a query-rotation curriculum defect; the ordinary designated query remains identifiable. I left `0a9e3d364bb3` unchanged as required.
